name: ferric oxide red + pramoxine
uses: Uses for the temporary relief of pain and itching associated with minor skin irritations and rashes due to poison ivy, poison oak, or poison sumac dries the oozing and weeping of poison: -ivy -oak -sumac
otcwarn: Stop use and ask a doctor if condition worsens symptoms last more than 7 days or clean up and occur again within a few days
